# List only retained engine ADRs (including 0004 and 0007) in learn/tree.json

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 3 (`retained-decisions-nav`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `claimed by @neo-gemini-julia`

## The Problem

Under `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` → `"Retained Decisions"` (`AgentInterfaces/Decisions`) in `learn/tree.json`:
1. Five entries (`0020-agent-harness-concept`, `0032-institution-cockpit-render-model`, `0034-electron-shell-architecture`, `0037-fleet-manager-outward-door-topology`, `0038-fm-client-topology`) are `type: redirect` pointer files (`"Moved to Agent Institution"`) visible without `"hidden": true` in the navigation tree.
2. Meanwhile, two substantive accepted engine ADR files in `learn/agentos/decisions/` — `0004-github-content-architecture.md` and `0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` — are missing from `learn/tree.json`.

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 3 `retained-decisions-nav`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/agentos/decisions/` holds two classes of files on `dev`:
  - **7 Retained Engine ADRs:** `0004-github-content-architecture`, `0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy`, `0008-skill-anatomy-and-authoring-contract`, `0018-neo-identity-source-of-truth-model`, `0021-extended-nl-multi-writer-write-enforcement`, `0029-docking-design`, `0031-target-architecture-composition` (substantive decision records governing `neomjs/neo`).
  - **5 Redirect Pointer Files (`type: redirect`):** `0020-agent-harness-concept`, `0032-institution-cockpit-render-model`, `0034-electron-shell-architecture`, `0037-fleet-manager-outward-door-topology`, `0038-fm-client-topology` (kept on disk and in `learn/tree.json` with `"hidden": true` so historical `#/learn/agentos/decisions/...` routes and `seo.json` `noindex, follow` entries in `Generate.spec.mjs` remain intact while `Neo.tree.List#createItem` hides them from the visible sidebar).

## The Fix

1. In `learn/tree.json` under `"Retained Decisions"` (`AgentInterfaces/Decisions`), add `"0004 — GitHub Content Architecture"` (`agentos/decisions/0004-github-content-architecture`) and `"0007 — Compaction Taxonomy"` (`agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy`) in numerical order alongside `0008`, `0018`, `0021`, `0029`, and `0031`.
2. Mark the 5 `type: redirect` entries (`0020`, `0032`, `0034`, `0037`, `0038`) with `"hidden": true` in `learn/tree.json` and keep their `.md` files on disk in `learn/agentos/decisions/`.
3. Add a unit assertion in `test/playwright/unit/app/content/TreeList.spec.mjs` verifying that visible leaves under `AgentInterfaces/Decisions` match the 7 substantive retained Engine ADRs while all 5 redirect pointers carry `"hidden": true`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/tree.json` (`AgentInterfaces/Decisions` children) | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 3 + `src/tree/List.mjs#createItem` | Visible `"Retained Decisions"` items are the 7 substantive retained engine ADRs (`0004`, `0007`, `0008`, `0018`, `0021`, `0029`, `0031`); the 5 `type: redirect` entries carry `"hidden": true` and remain on disk | Preserves `#/learn/agentos/decisions/0020..0038` route resolution and `seo.json` `noindex, follow` invariants (`Generate.spec.mjs:1367`) | `learn/tree.json` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` + `TreeList.spec.mjs` + `LearnCorpusLinks.spec.mjs` + `Generate.spec.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: `aligned-with` `neomjs/neo#adr:github-content-architecture` (`0004`), `neomjs/neo#adr:agents-md-compaction-taxonomy` (`0007`), and `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#adr:adrs-as-graph-queryable-entities` (`0006` §2.9).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** Visible leaves under `"Retained Decisions"` (`AgentInterfaces/Decisions`) in `learn/tree.json` list all 7 substantive retained engine ADRs (`0004`, `0007`, `0008`, `0018`, `0021`, `0029`, `0031`), while the 5 `type: redirect` pointer entries (`0020`, `0032`, `0034`, `0037`, `0038`) carry `"hidden": true` (pinned by `TreeList.spec.mjs`).
- [ ] **AC-2:** All 5 redirect pointer `.md` files remain on disk in `learn/agentos/decisions/` and pass `Generate.spec.mjs` and `Verify.spec.mjs`.
- [ ] **AC-3:** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs`, `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs`, and `LearnCorpusLinks.spec.mjs` pass with `0` errors without hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml`, `apps/portal/llms.txt`, or `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`.

## Out of Scope

Deleting the redirect `.md` files from `learn/agentos/decisions/` or hand-editing pipeline/release-generated SEO outputs (`apps/portal/sitemap.xml`, `apps/portal/llms.txt`, `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`).

## Avoided Traps

- Deleting redirect `.md` files or dropping their hidden `tree.json` route ids (breaks `Generate.spec.mjs:1367` `noindex, follow` parity and historical `#/learn/...` links).
- Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §5).
